AuthorDetails.Description: A full stack developer with a particular focus on .NET, Angular and NodeJS development.

Description:
AWS S3 media storage for Umbraco 15-18 on .NET 9 and .NET 10. Provides an S3-backed IFileSystem, direct media delivery, and S3 caching for ImageSharp transforms. Supports configurable media and cache prefixes, localized upload validation, optional cache cleanup, startup connectivity checks, and opt-in smoke endpoints. Auto-composed; no Program.cs changes required.

Release 1.4.2 highlights:
- Delivers original S3 media when URLs contain unrelated query parameters such as Umbraco's cache-busting v parameter.
- Maps asynchronous AWS failures correctly and returns not-found responses for missing media instead of HTTP 500.
- Corrects ImageSharp provider ordering, reuses S3 metadata, and keeps transformed-image caching in S3.
- Adds .NET 9 and .NET 10 regression coverage for delivery, exception handling, provider ordering, and custom processors.
